description: Manage non-player characters in the active Novel. create requires a name; ruleset_reference links a stat block without copying it; mind is GM-only and never returned to the Player badge; remove deletes the NPC permanently. create, update, and remove require the GM or Editor badge, persist to the Novel, are audited, and are undoable via manage_history (action: undo); list and get are read-only. Use when: introducing, revising, removing, listing, or reading NPCs. Do NOT use when: managing player characters — use manage_character (action: create/import/sheet).

action.description: create, update, remove, list, get, import_card, or export_card.

card.description: Character Card V3 JSON object or string (import_card).

confirm_lore.description: Import the card's character_book as lore entries (import_card).

detail.description: Return full NPC records instead of summary entries (list).

auto_play.description: When true, the narrator plays this NPC from the directive on initiative.

directive.description: Narrator-facing directive describing how to play this NPC (GM only).

identity_core.description: Stable values, bonds, and taboos (GM only).

name: manage_npc

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or an error category (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: NPC Management
